result.title: Consommé: Conditioned Token Merging for Split Inference
result.summary: Split inference partitions a Vision Transformer between a resource-constrained edge device and a server. However, transmitting intermediate tokens across the communication channel is costly. Deploying fine-tuned backbones to every endpoint becomes expensive as well. We study token reduction for split inference under a frozen backbone, where only a small adapter is shipped. We observe that the CLS token plays a dual role: it acts as the global summary the receiver needs for classification, and it serves as a signal on which patches to keep. We propose Consommé, a method utilizing both characteristics. There, an information bottleneck compresses the CLS token into a compact latent which is transmitted in place of the full CLS token and conditions a learned patch gate merging patches into exactly $k$ tokens via soft assignment. It reaches any budget in a single step, thus escaping the per-layer cap of bipartite matching (BPM). On DeiT-S/T, it leads all methods at aggressive token budgets and remains operable at shallow splits where BPM cannot operate, while matching fine-tuned methods at gentle budgets at a fraction of their deployment cost.

AI.brief_summary: 研究冻结 ViT 主干下 split inference 的 token 缩减：用信息瓶颈把 CLS 压缩为紧凑 latent 传输，并以其为条件学习 patch gate，通过软分配一步合并到任意 k 个 token。
AI.relevance_reason: 「压缩后的 latent 作为条件信号筛选视觉 token」可能与 LVR 的内部状态瓶颈、视觉证据筛选和计算预算控制相关，可供核查；但其目标主要是通信效率而非推理机制。
